relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with irisin also downregulated the expression of the glial cell activation-related markers Iba-1 and GFAP in the spinal cord tissue.

key_findings: Irisin reduced CFA-induced allodynia and hyperalgesia, shifting macrophages toward M2 and lowering M1 cytokines including TNF-α.
Irisin downregulated TLR4, MyD88 and IRF5 and spinal glial activation.
